subject: general
question:
Harsh is the son of Ajeet. Vinita is the wife of Ajeet. Ajay is the brother of Harsh. Neha is the only daughter of Ajay and Kavita.

How is Vinita related to Neha?
solution:
Family chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6877a1b816099374a867f12c3bc330cccbc068a3cdab6c047266babdd64a5185.png] 

Given:

 
• Harsh is the son of Ajeet.
 
• Vinita is the wife of Ajeet.
 
• Ajay is the brother of Harsh.
 
• Neha is the only daughter of Ajay and Kavita.

According to the statement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1994b91d5eb588b9bc72a36a1b6212dfaf7eebe1aaaeec4f32de3b55b34d998.png] 

**Vinita is the father's mother of Neha** i.e. her paternal grandmother.

Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.
